description: Create a new contact in the organization's address book. If notes are provided, they are saved as a structured note entry with source tracking.

doNotAutoRespond.description: If true, the bot will never auto-respond to this contact (manual/API and human sends still work)

doNotBroadcast.description: If true, this contact is permanently excluded from all broadcasts

notes.description: Additional notes about the contact, saved as a structured entry

phone.description: Contact phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +2348012345678)

name: neuron_create_contact
title: Create Contact
